title: Causal Chain Tracing + Fix Station UI
built: src/main.ts — full app wiring: project open, analyze, finding click, ADB profiling, Settings modal
Intelligence Feed: real-time DOM-append stream showing Bob's reasoning per finding
Fix Station: finding detail card, causal chain tree (nested ul with CSS connectors), code diff block, copy button
Project Navigator: file tree with severity color dots, active file highlighting
ADB dynamic profiling: Start/Stop Profile buttons using tauri-plugin-shell with settings.adbPath
Grade badge real-time update as findings accumulate during scan
Export Report button wiring to report.html generation
bob_reasoning: The causal chain tree is rendered as nested <ul> elements with CSS ::before pseudo-elements drawing the connector lines — no SVG or canvas required. Each ChainNode from traceCallChain() becomes a <li> with class 'chain-root', 'chain-intermediate', or 'chain-symptom'. The Intelligence Feed uses DOM appendChild — not innerHTML reassignment — so each finding entry is appended without clearing previous entries. This preserves the 'streaming reasoning' feel as the analyzer runs.
key_decisions: CSS connector lines for causal chain tree (no SVG)
ADB path read from settings at call time (not cached)
Report export via plugin-fs writeTextFile with injected JSON blob
